title: Dynamical models of cluster members to probe the total mass properties of cluster subhalos. I. Comparison with parametric strong lensing in Abell 2744 and MACS J0416
efc_relevance: Reveals systematic discrepancy between dynamical subhalo masses and parametric strong-lensing reconstructions in two flagship JWST clusters. The same systematic propagates into Bullet/AS1063 δκ pipelines and is a control variable for EFC's sealed Bullet test (figshare 31963668) — must be folded into the EFC δκ error budget.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as cluster-lensing systematic; update Stage-IV Roadmap Bullet pipeline error-budget; cross-reference arXiv:2503.21870, arXiv:2601.22245 and arXiv:2605.10022.
